WITH patient_level AS (
    SELECT 
        l.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(l.ALB) as patient_avg_alb,
        AVG(CASE 
            WHEN l.UN IS NOT NULL AND l.`T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND l.`T-BIL` != 0
            THEN l.UN / l.`T-BIL`
        END) as patient_avg_ratio
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_level AS (
    SELECT 
        SEX,
        AVG(patient_avg_alb) as sex_avg_alb,
        AVG(patient_avg_ratio) as sex_avg_ratio
    FROM patient_level
    GROUP BY SEX
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(sex_avg_alb) as overall_mean_alb
    FROM sex_level
)
SELECT 
    sl.SEX,
    sl.sex_avg_alb,
    sl.sex_avg_ratio,
    sl.sex_avg_alb - om.overall_mean_alb as alb_above_mean
FROM sex_level sl
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE sl.sex_avg_alb > om.overall_mean_alb

assumptions.assumption: T-BIL = 0 is treated as a non-computable denominator and excluded from the UN/T-BIL ratio calculation. This follows from 'ratios that can't be computed' being ignored.
